headline: Guardian Real Estate Sells Nine Properties for R$ 792 Million
summary: Guardian Real Estate agreed to sell a portfolio of nine properties to Riza Renda Imobiliária Master, reducing its exposure to Carrefour.
why: Real estate investment fund (FII) asset sales and portfolio rebalancing transactions alter asset concentration and capital distribution for listed property vehicles.

impacts.name: Guardian Real Estate
impacts.why: Asset sales generate liquidity and affect portfolio composition for the real estate fund.
